verdict.rationale: Claude ships a built-in assistant (Claude.ai chat) with tool use, memory, file/code execution, task hand-off/scheduling, and a Managed Agents harness for delegating long-running tasks, backed by tool-use, MCP connector, and Skills docs. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of task delegation reliability in the consumer product (community evidence is mostly about API/Claude Code performance, not the built-in assistant's delegation UX).
